  Alhambra City Council

  MINUTES
  Special Meeting
  ALHAMBRA CITY COUNCIL
  April 17, 2025
  11:00 a.m.

ROLL CALL: At 11:46 a.m., on Thursday, April 17, 2025, the Alhambra City Council met in the
Ballroom of The Granada LA located at 17 South First Street, Alhambra, California.

CITY COUNCIL:  PRESENT:  MAZA, WANG, LEE
  ABSENT:  MALONEY, ANDRADE-STADLER

Officials Present: City Manager Binnquist, Assistant City Manager Garcia, Deputy City Manager
Stover, City Attorney Montes, City Clerk Myles, Director of Parks & Recreation Macias, Director of
Library Services LohGuan, Director of Public Works/Utilities Ahlen, Director of Finance Lieu, Director
of Human Resources Ko, Director of Community Development Ho, Fire Chief Ragusa, Chief of
Police Kennedy

CITY CLERK REPORT - NOTICE NO. N2M25-44

The City Clerk reported that she duly gave notice of the special meeting of the City Council being
held this morning pursuant to the order of the Mayor and in accordance with Section 54956 of the
Government Code of the State of California.

1.  CITY OF ALHAMBRA: STATE OF THE CITY ADDRESS – F2M25-16

  Mayor LEE presented the State of the City address regarding various accomplishments,
  issues and projects underway in the City of Alhambra. A copy of the presentation is on file
in the City Clerk’s Office.

  Public Comment:  None

  Discussion:  None

ADJOURNMENT: At 12:04 p.m., Mayor LEE adjourned the meeting.

  LAUREN MYLES, CMC
  CITY CLERK
